title: Infant Sleep Machines and Hazardous Sound Pressure Levels
source_conditions: 14 infant sleep machines at maximum volume; 30/100/200 cm; correction factors for a 6-month-old's ear canal
applicability: Dedicated devices at max volume, not typical use levels; smartphones not included; the 50 dBA figure is itself borrowed from hospital nursery recommendations (1-hour average)
notes: Verified against the primary abstract 2026-11-17. All devices >50 dBA at 30 cm; 3 devices >85 dBA.

title: White noise machines and infant hearing (review), Sleep Medicine 2024
source_conditions: Reanalysis of existing data: 24 machines and 6 phone apps; all could exceed NIOSH 85 dBA 8-hour REL at some setting; authors recommend ~60 dBA
applicability: Adult occupational limits used as surrogate (no infant-specific standard); 60 dBA is an author recommendation, not a standard
notes: Secondary-corroborated: existence and headline findings agree across 3+ news reports (ABC News et al.); primary methods not yet checked.

title: Preventing Excessive Noise Exposure in Infants, Children, and Adolescents (AAP policy statement, Pediatrics 2023)
source_conditions: Policy statement on noise exposure in children broadly
applicability: Reported to give distance/volume/duration guidance without a specific dB cap for infant devices
notes: Existence verified via secondary sources 2026-11-17; primary text not yet read.
